tasks.label: Build
tasks.command: mkdir -p build/generated && touch build/generated/autoconfig.input && make CHIP=${input:chip} BOARD=${input:board} CROSS_COMPILE=riscv64-unknown-elf-

tasks.label: Flash
tasks.command: PORT=$(ls /dev/tty.usbserial-* 2>/dev/null | head -1) && if [ -z $PORT ]; then echo 'ERROR: No USB serial port found.'; exit 1; fi && echo 'Flashing to '$PORT && ${input:sdk}/tools/bflb_tools/bouffalo_flash_cube/BLFlashCube --interface=uart --port=$PORT --baudrate=2000000 --config=${workspaceFolder}/build/flash_prog_cfg.ini

tasks.label: Build and Flash
tasks.command: mkdir -p build/generated && touch build/generated/autoconfig.input && make CHIP=${input:chip} BOARD=${input:board} CROSS_COMPILE=riscv64-unknown-elf- && PORT=$(ls /dev/tty.usbserial-* 2>/dev/null | head -1) && if [ -z $PORT ]; then echo 'ERROR: No USB serial port found.'; exit 1; fi && echo 'Flashing to '$PORT && ${input:sdk}/tools/bflb_tools/bouffalo_flash_cube/BLFlashCube --interface=uart --port=$PORT --baudrate=2000000 --config=${workspaceFolder}/build/flash_prog_cfg.ini

tasks.label: Serial Monitor
tasks.command: PORT=$(ls /dev/tty.usbserial-* 2>/dev/null | head -1) && if [ -z $PORT ]; then echo 'ERROR: No USB serial port found.'; exit 1; fi && echo 'Opening serial monitor on '$PORT && screen $PORT 2000000
